canonical_formulas.ilr_via_helmert: ilr(x) = clr(x) @ H.T  where H is the (D-1) x D Helmert orthonormal contrast matrix
canonical_formulas.helmert_basis_row_k: row k (zero-indexed): n=k+1, norm=1/sqrt(n*(n+1)); first n entries = +norm, entry n = -n*norm, rest = 0
canonical_formulas.s_j_sensitivity_vector: s_j(x) = 1/x_j  (order-1 carrier steering sensitivity; DISTINCT from kappa^HS)
canonical_formulas.metric_involution: M(x) = C(1/x)  ;  M(M(x)) = x  (algebraic identity; data must respect it at IEEE floor)
canonical_formulas.rotation_quaternion_atan2_stable: given unit u1, u2 in R^3:  cross = u1 x u2,  dot = clip(u1.u2, -1, 1),  angle = atan2(||cross||, dot),  q = quat_from_axis_angle(cross/||cross||, angle)
canonical_formulas.sandwich_product: rotate(q, v) = (q . [0;v] . q*).xyz  where q* = quat_conj(q)
canonical_formulas.hamilton_product_noncommutative: i*j = k, j*i = -k (right-hand convention; matches cnq.py and cnq.R)
canonical_formulas.cnq_content_sha256: SHA-256 of canonical-JSON encoding of payload (sort_keys=True, separators=',:', ensure_ascii=True, allow_nan=False) AFTER stripping clock-dependent fields {generated, timestamp, wall_clock, _run_clock}
